thread:
andrea: Quick check — during the Next Bootcamp samplekit walkthrough I noticed the SDK auth backoff isn't honoring retries when the refresh token endpoint returns 502 intermittently. Anyone seen this?
sam: Ugh yes. I saw it yesterday when running the starter with env var REDWOOD_SDK=0.8.2. Repro steps:
sam: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:3000/api/generate
# service returns 502 then SDK fails with "invalid_token" instead of retry
```
maria: I think the client side retry logic expects 429/5xx but misses 502 because the auth middleware returns 502 wrapped in HTML. We sanitize for json only.
luke: Can you paste the network failure? Is it coming from dedicated vs hosted? :eyes:
andrea: Hosted sandbox (eu-1), but local dev repro is trivial. Stack trace:
andrea: ```
Error: invalid_token
    at AuthClient._fetch (/workspace/node_modules/...)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process...)
```
sam: Patch idea — if auth fetch returns non-JSON, do a 1s backoff and retry up to 3x, then fall back to anonymous token. Might fix bootcamp flow.
maria: Agree. Also the Next samplekit README suggests REDWOOD_NO_AUTO_RETRY=false which is confusing. I'll file a docs PR.
dev-bot: New issue created: #1234 "samplekit: auth backoff for non-JSON 502" by maria
andrea: Thanks. For now a workaround: set FAST_RETRY=true and add an axios interceptor to coerce 502 body -> {}
luke: I'll try a small SDK patch for this and drop a beta later today.
andrea: :thumbsup: LMK when it's up so I can update the bootcamp slides.
